items.title: Kroger cuts forecast as inflation and grocery price war squeeze sales
items.summary: Kroger has lowered its annual sales forecast due to persistent inflation and intense competition in the grocery sector, which are impacting consumer spending. The company expects comparable sales excluding fuel to grow by a maximum of 0.8%, down from a previous estimate of 2%. CEO Greg Foran is implementing strategies like price reductions and improved store services to gain market share amidst a challenging economic environment where consumers are tightening budgets.

items.title: Food industry warns prices will go up for rest of year
items.summary: Food industry giants like Conagra, Campbell's, and Clorox are signaling upcoming price increases for their products due to persistent inflation, tariffs, and rising input costs. Executives cite elevated energy, fertilizer, and transportation expenses, along with potential El Niño disruptions, as key drivers. While retailers will decide how much of these increases to absorb, consumers are expected to face higher grocery bills for the remainder of the year.

items.title: Q2 Earnings Review: Industrial Packaging Stocks Led by Avery Dennison (NYSE:AVY)
items.summary: The article reviews the Q2 earnings season for industrial packaging stocks, highlighting Avery Dennison (NYSE:AVY) as a top performer with strong revenue growth. It also details the performance of other key players like Crown Holdings, Packaging Corporation of America, International Paper, and Silgan Holdings, noting that while the sector reported strong revenues, share prices have generally declined since earnings reports. The piece touches on recent market uncertainties, including AI and geopolitical events, but emphasizes the importance of strong fundamentals.

items.title: State Street Launches Inflation Drivers Data “Super” Set
items.summary: State Street has launched PriceStats Superset, a new global dataset providing daily, item-level pricing data across 27 countries and millions of products. This dataset helps investors, policymakers, and researchers better understand inflation drivers in advance of government data releases, offering a more timely and transparent view of price pressures. It builds on the existing PriceStats service by providing access to underlying item-level data, allowing users to trace inflation dynamics from individual products to headline figures.

items.title: GrafTech and Antora Energy Partner to Power American Industry with Carbon
items.summary: GrafTech International Ltd. and Antora Energy have announced a strategic collaboration to develop and supply carbon-based materials for Antora's thermal batteries. This partnership will strengthen the domestic manufacturing base for American energy technology, leveraging GrafTech's St. Marys facility and creating new jobs. The collaboration aims to utilize carbon to store energy, making American factories more competitive and supporting the growth of the domestic energy storage supply chain.

items.title: Destination XL maps out a turnaround plan
items.summary: Destination XL's second-quarter sales declined by 3.4% year over year, with interim CEO Lionel Conacher anticipating an imminent resumption of sales growth despite challenges like reduced store traffic. The company is implementing a four-pillar growth strategy, including store closures and expanding private label brands, while also acknowledging the impact of GLP-1 medications on customer purchasing behavior.

items.title: General Mills saw base pricing reduction as ‘biggest issue’
items.summary: General Mills executives discussed their decision to lower base prices as a pivotal move at the Barclays Global Consumer Staples Conference. This strategy, aimed at addressing pricing gaps and improving value, led to improved results, including stabilized base volume and growth in household penetration for most categories. Despite a slower-than-expected volume recovery and the need to fix underperforming brands, the company is confident in its position for future growth as it shifts focus to innovation.

items.title: Attack damages Bunge oilseeds plant in Ukraine
items.summary: A Bunge Global SA oilseeds processing plant in Dnipro, Ukraine, was damaged on September 10 by a Russian attack. No employees were injured in the incident. This attack is part of an intensifying trend where both Russia and Ukraine target each other's agricultural infrastructure, severely impacting agricultural exports and global vegetable oil supplies.

items.title: September ICE Mortgage Monitor: Annual home price growth was 1.5% in August
items.summary: The September ICE Mortgage Monitor reports that while annual home price growth reached 1.5% in August, there are signs that this growth is beginning to cool. The report also highlights that property insurance costs are rising, contributing significantly to monthly mortgage payments, but the pace of increase is slowing. Homeowners who switched insurance carriers achieved notable savings, while mortgage delinquency rates saw a decrease in July.
